notes: Fixes Vault authorization being lost when navigating from the Hub to Quick Reference in the same browser tab. The 30-minute authorized session is now also carried in volatile window.name tab memory, while BroadcastChannel remains available for other open TEE tabs. No decrypted Vault data is written to persistent localStorage. Adaptive Checklist and encrypted Vault records are unchanged.
name: TEE v3.4.71 — Same-Tab Vault Continuity
